meta.inspection: All 25 PNGs individually opened with view_image; only supplied image paths inspected. No keys, game source or other judges read. Phone-like displayed landscape scale; static craft only.
meta.anchors: Recognizable unchanged images retain exact prior five-category scores; no assumed iteration order.
meta.blinding_limitations: Visual families and repeated controls remain recognizable. Sci-fi reference resembles StarCraft; battlefield references resemble Company of Heroes. Tactical interior/market title uncertain. These associations are unverified and do not determine scoring.

view-01.png.evidence: Warm/cool room lighting, thick walls and contrasting floor materials create convincing interior volume; restrained rings and cones preserve layout.
view-01.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Tiny characters/labels remain demanding at phone size. Recognizable unchanged reference; exact anchor retained.

view-02.png.evidence: Fog layers, autumn trees, track marks and damaged buildings produce atmospheric material depth.
view-02.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Small units merge with textured ground and haze. Unchanged reference anchor.

view-03.png.evidence: Darker subdued trees, service compound/vehicle bays, dirt tracks and hangar walls give the airfield purposeful terrain structure. Pale player outline separates its wings better from blue roof.
view-03.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Compound vehicles and fences remain tiny; dark tree contacts are heavy and broad grass mottling still flat. Player is improved but still overlaps roof detail.

view-04.png.evidence: Warm worn market paving, produce stalls and props give varied surfaces; colored planned paths are traceable.
view-04.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Small brown figures merge into environment. Unchanged reference anchor.

view-12.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Smoke/spark dots repeat and stern remains crowded by texture and aircraft. Unchanged prior control; exact anchor retained.

view-24.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Dark infantry and vehicles merge into ground at phone size. Unchanged reference anchor.

view-25.png.evidence: Sharp roof trim and coast rocks, olive ground variation and shaded trees enrich a quiet land view.
view-25.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Ground is busy without height changes; rocks by plane compete slightly. Unchanged prior control.

general_next_priorities: Player edge contrast visibly helps in sparse scenes, especially over roof and grass. Dense carrier fight still needs occlusion handling or a restrained player indicator that survives stacked plane silhouettes.
The service compound and dirt lanes add purposeful terrain structure. Extend material transitions around hangars/roads and beach shallows rather than adding more uniform grass mottling.
Continuous tan deck is more coherent than the broad dark block, but material depth still requires a lit side face, convincing hull contact and localized deck wear/shadow variation.
Preserve visible long wakes while introducing widening, fragmented turbulence and transparent decay instead of two near-parallel blurred streaks.

Dense combat remains below references in effects hierarchy: distinguish hot impact cores, fire/debris and fading smoke by scale, brightness and lifetime. Static dot density is not evidence of polished impacts.
Keep muted tree palette but soften the nearly black repeated contact patches. Improvements should retain the strong clear HUD and avoid overloading the focal play area.
